labels.label: noise
labels.reason: This is just the install/upgrade command for the package managers and describes no change in behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: TypeScript users must also upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom, which is required migration work that could cause type errors if skipped.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The minimum Node.js version was raised from 16.14 to 18.17, which can break environments and deployments running older Node.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The next export command was removed and must be replaced with output: 'export' config, requiring build script and config changes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The ImageResponse import moved from next/server to next/og, so existing imports break unless renamed (codemod available).

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The @next/font package was fully removed in favor of next/font, requiring import changes for users of the old package.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The WASM target for next-swc was removed, which can break deployments or environments relying on the WASM build.
